title: GPT-4o Lacks Core Features of Theory of Mind

prompt.location: Methods (ContainerWorld/MovieWorld paradigms); "all system and user prompts are available on OSF"
prompt.note: System prompt gives the task and a JSON response schema; user prompt is a parametrically generated belief/desire/state vignette ending in a fixed question.

claim.metric: % Agreement with expected (human-like ToM) action prediction, ContainerWorld

notes: 243 = 9(beliefs) x 3(desires) x 9(states) tuples for the ContainerWorld forward-prediction task (Study 1). The paper also reports several cross-paradigm correlations (e.g. r=.78 for belief inferences) and a MovieWorld replication with its own tuple counts.
